fragments.title: Finance
fragments.body: Budgeting and reporting separated from operational activity.

fragments.title: Operations
fragments.body: Critical workflows hidden inside one-off tools and manual routines.

fragments.title: Customers
fragments.body: Service history lives apart from the team delivering it.

fragments.title: Field teams
fragments.body: Updates happen quickly but rarely reach the system of record.

fragments.title: Management
fragments.body: Decisions wait for reports to be assembled by hand.

fragments.title: Data
fragments.body: Duplicated records drift until nobody knows which is current.

method.title: Understand
method.body: Study users, workflows, constraints, systems, and goals. Define the real problem.

method.title: Design
method.body: Define architecture, workflows, integrations, and experience before change becomes expensive.

method.title: Engineer
method.body: Build, test, and deploy with technologies appropriate to the system.

method.title: Integrate
method.body: Connect data, tools, infrastructure, and the operating environment.

method.title: Improve
method.body: Learn from real use and evolve the system as requirements change.

systems.title: Processes
systems.body: Workflows, handoffs, approvals and operating rules.

systems.title: Data
systems.body: Information that stays accurate, useful and available.

systems.title: Technology
systems.body: Applications, integrations and infrastructure chosen for the job.
